easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
description:
Activate Morgue Toad by sacrificing it, adding {U}{R}.
When Morgue Toad dies, Yedora triggers, returning Morgue Toad from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Morgue Toad enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Morgue Toad by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Morgue Toad face-up.
Repeat.
